Caroline (Eval): FYI nightly-eval (run 2026-03-19T23:00Z) shows a cluster of long-context regressions on redwood-claude-like-v2.3-quant8. Many examples look like instruction truncation / lost instructions rather than hallucinations. +24 fails vs yesterday baseline.

Alice (ML): can you paste a representative sample? is this happening on fp16 too or only quant?

Caroline (Eval): Sample (prompt ~9.2k tokens, trimmed):
```
SYSTEM: You are an assistant. Follow instructions exactly.
USER:
<very long chain of context...>
INSTRUCTION: Summarize the steps in the final paragraph in 3 bullets.
```
Model output (quant8):
```
The steps are: 1) ... 2) ... 3) ...
[TRUNCATED] 
```
Expected: full 3 bullets with explicit numbered steps. Output stops mid-sentence; second instruction in context later is ignored.

Ben (Infra): did nightly run hit any memory pressure / OOMs on the pgbatch nodes? Could be prefix eviction.

nightly-bot: nightly-eval summary: model=redwood-claude-like-v2.3-quant8 run_id=run-20260319-2315 regressions=24 regressions_longctx=19 flaky=3 baseline_model=redwood-claude-like-v2.2-fp16

Dmitri (Runtime): interesting — we merged kernel selection change in commit a1b2c3 (PR #478) last night. That change tweaks kv-cache slot packing for quantized kernels. Might be miscomputing slot offsets for >8k sequences.

Caroline (Eval): repro steps I used: 1) start local container with model v2.3-quant8, 2) run eval harness longctx-suite v3, 3) sample deterministic topk=1 to avoid sampling noise. Repro rate ~95% on 12 seeds. run_id: run-20260319-2315. Logs attached (snippet):
```
[kv-store] seq_len=9234 kv_slots=1153 expected_offset=9216 actual_offset=9088
[decode] truncated at token_idx=4127 (request len ~9234)
```

Alice (ML): if expected_offset vs actual_offset differ by ~128 that's suspicious — looks like a prefix alignment mismatch. Is this only quant8? have you tried fp16 and int4?

Caroline (Eval): fp16 (v2.2-fp16 baseline) does not show the truncation. int4 experiments (internal) show a couple failures but far fewer. quant8 shows highest regression count.

Dmitri (Runtime): I'll run a debug build with added assertions around kv offset computations. suspect integer division / alignment in the quantized kernel path. Also will try to re-run the same workload but forcing legacy kernel.

Eva (SRE): infra note — during the 23:00Z window we had a transient NVLink hiccup on pool-gpu-3 (PGID 14). One pod restarted but low restart rate (1). Might affect streaming of large KV pages if I/O windows align.

Ben (Infra): can we isolate to a single instance reproducible run? Caroline, can you provide the exact container image tag and the node id for a failing run?

Caroline (Eval): image: redwood-infer:v2.3-quant8-20260319-a1b2c3, node: pool-gpu-3-nd-14. I saved a raw trace: s3://redwood-eval/traces/run-20260319-2315/trace-9234.jsonl

Alice (ML): plan: 1) Dmitri to confirm kernel offset math on quant path, 2) Caroline to repro on different node with same image, 3) Ben/Eva to check for correlated infra events and retest without NVLink burst, 4) try fp16 vs quant8 side-by-side to confirm model state identical.

Dmitri (Runtime): started a local reproduce with the trace. Quick diff shows that during KV stitching we drop the last 128 tokens when slot_rem % alignment != 0. Patch candidate in branch runtime/fix-kv-align-128. Running eval now (ETA ~20m).

nightly-bot: triggered: regression-investigation ticket created #INF-2127 assigned=Dmitri,Caroline,priority=P2 link=https://redwood.internal/issue/INF-2127

Caroline (Eval): good. I'll also push a minimized test case to make it easier for CI. attaching failing prompt id=lc-20260319-9832.

Alice (ML): also add quantization bisect: run q8->q6->fp mapping to see where the break happens. if alignment bug in kernel it's likely independent of quant level but shows up more for q8 packing.

Eva (SRE): tagging this with "long-context" and "kv-cache" in infra monitoring. I'll increase debug retention on pool-gpu-3 for 24h.

Caroline (Eval): thanks all — assigning myself to verify CI reproducer. will update INF-2127 with reproducer and baseline diff once Dmitri's patch result is in. :thumbsup:
